name: 48043 · Mount Clemens, MI
findings: ZIP 48043 (Mount Clemens) has 95 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 37 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48043 (Mount Clemens) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 48043 (Mount Clemens) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 37 organizations here; 39% of all organizations here have no identified type.
